name: amazon-sqs
description: Reads Amazon SQS queues and executes typed, approval-gated SQS message and queue actions through fixed AWS Query API operations.

risk.read: signed, bounded Amazon SQS Query API reads against the configured queue or derived regional endpoint; ReceiveMessage can change message visibility per SQS semantics
risk.write: typed SendMessage, queue administration, permission, tag, visibility, delete, purge, and dead-letter redrive operations against fixed SQS targets only
risk.approval: all reverse ETL/provider write commands require plan, preview, explicit approval, and destructive confirmation for delete/purge/cancel/remove operations

conformance.reason: Tier-3 native SigV4/XML SQS Query API; dynamic declarative replay is skipped because the declarative engine cannot execute AWS Query XML or SigV4 flows; native httptest fixtures cover SigV4 signing, credential-free fixture reads, direct-read validation/redaction, and representative typed write serialization
